description: This file contains the abstract class definition for SugarCache, which provides a base implementation for caching mechanisms in the SuiteCRM system. It manages cache interactions, local caching, statistics, and abstract methods for external cache backend implementations.

classes.name: SugarCacheAbstract
classes.description: An abstract base class that defines common cache functionality, including local caching, cache statistics, and abstract methods for backend-specific cache operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes cache timeout and key prefix based on global configuration.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache value for a given key, checking the local store and external cache.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a cache value for a given key, delegating to the 'set' method.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in both local and external cache, with optional TTL.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a cache key exists.

methods.name: __unset
methods.description: Removes a cache key from local and external cache.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the local cache store for the current request.

methods.name: resetFull
methods.description: Performs a full reset of both local and external caches.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears the local cache and resets the external cache.

methods.name: getCacheStats
methods.description: Returns cache request statistics including hits and misses.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string identifier for the cache backend.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Abstract method to set a cache value in the external backend.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a cache value from the external backend.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Abstract method to clear a cache value from the external backend.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Abstract method to reset the external cache.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if the cache backend should be used based on configuration and system state.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority level for the cache backend.
